newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N end up at 20.50 pct in tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N end up at 20.50 pct in tight liquidity.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed firmer on Wednesday as banks started the two-week reserve period with tighter liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 20.50 percent, after opening at 19.875/20.25 percent and compared to Tuesday's close of 19 percent.

"Lack of liquidity characterised the market," said Sandor Szatmari of Creditanstalt. "A lot of money must have been placed in the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility... possibly on Tuesday."
The central bank's one-week reverse repo facility stands at 20 percent and some banks may have decided on Tuesday to put money in reverse repo as overnight rates dropped to 19 percent yesterday.
